from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEPSData(BaseModel):
    """Earnings per share data extracted from one company's financial report"""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name in Chinese")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/security code, e.g., '002415'")
    basic_eps: float | None = Field(description="Basic earnings per share for the period, in Yuan/share")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="Diluted earnings per share for the period, in Yuan/share")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024 Q1'")
    is_negative: bool = Field(description="Whether the basic EPS is negative (indicating loss)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_data: list[CompanyEPSData]
